svg.title: Skill crystallization from repeated RPE into habit track
svg.desc: Early encounters route through full deliberation. After enough consistent positive RPE, the pattern crystallizes into the skill library and future encounters take the fast habit track directly.
svg.text: same situation type encountered repeatedly over time

g.text: situation is novel · RPE history unstable · full deliberation required

svg.text: after N consistent positive RPE for this (situation-type, action) pair…

g.text: basal ganglia writes pattern to skill library
situation matches crystallized pattern · reasoning bypassed entirely
skills grow from where the agent actually encounters problems — not from what a designer anticipated.
